summary: The approach is right and the acceptance criteria are testable. Two gaps: one criterion has no owner in the plan, and the error path for an over-broad pattern is described but not planned for.

findings.description: Acceptance criterion 2 ("once per captured line") is not observable from outside the package, so nothing in the plan can verify it.
findings.recommendation: Either drop it or state it as a property a test can read: one call to redact.Line per line written.

findings.description: The spec names a config key for the pattern table but does not say what an empty table means.
